Draw every whole plant from root to tip; no cropped parts, rigid cutouts, masks, ghosting, extra blades, or glow. Use image 2 only as original design reference; keep rendering and size of image 1. True alpha transparent background, no floor, no text.

prompts.release: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create two adjacent FULL-PLANT animation drawings in the same two square transparent cells. IMAGE 1 right plant is the pressed-down pose. IMAGE 2 left plant is the leftward elastic recoil. Draw the two missing moments BETWEEN them in chronological order, one-third then two-thirds of this gentle return. Keep rendering, plant scale and lower stem shape precisely consistent. The large dew drop moves gradually LEFT and slightly UP while the long leaf flexes, but never detaches. All four leaves and three dew drops remain the same design and size, and tallest leaf always curves LEFT. The short bare right leaf only flexes minimally. Roots aligned to the same ground height as the references. Preserve full continuous root-to-tip blades with natural curved sides, no fixed body cutout or sliced join. Transparent alpha, no text, no background, no glow, no framing change. Each cell is a complete plant with margins, not separate pieces.
